validation_scope: Public aggregate results only. Test identifiers and fixture hosts are synthetic; no account metadata or conversation content is included.

pause_stop_regression.scope: Local temporary state, fake remote RPC and synthetic commands only. No real enrollment, pairing or chat sends.

before_fix.result: Acknowledged pause/stop during preparation did not prevent shell dispatch; resource execution dropped supervisor binding.

after_fix.result: Pause/stop before dispatch rejects execution. Dispatch holds the supervisor control lock through the RPC receipt; concurrent control returns RECORD_BUSY. The lock releases after the receipt. Unknown execution retains resource lease without replay.

dependency_advisory_audit.scope: Installed and bundled npm dependencies from package.json, package-lock.json and npm ls --all. One package: ws 8.21.3; no transitive dependencies. Optional peers bufferutil/utf-8-validate are not installed or bundled.

positive_control.note: Read-only API query; vulnerable version was not installed or executed.

dependency_advisory_audit.remediation: No known affected dependency found; retain the existing exact pin and lockfile.
dependency_advisory_audit.limitations: Point-in-time known-advisory check, not proof of absence of unknown vulnerabilities. External Node/npm runtimes, Codex Desktop/native addons and OS components are not project npm dependencies and were not audited against their own advisory feeds.

publication_review.scope: Public source tree, PR-only commits, PR description/comments, and npm tarball. Environment-specific investigation records are excluded.

secret_scanner.name: Gitleaks
secret_scanner.configuration: Built-in rules; ignore-allow comments disabled; no repository suppression list.

privacy_controls: Examples and tests use synthetic UUIDs and fixture names only.
No personal home paths, real workstation names, real project/chat IDs or conversation transcripts.
Investigation notes excluded from the repository publication tree and npm file allowlist.
Local authentication, environment and diagnostic files ignored by Git.
publication_review.limitations: No scan proves absence of unknown secret formats. Removing current files or rewriting PR-only commits does not erase earlier base-branch history, third-party clones or hosting-provider caches.
